rule_family.theta_t_origin: fixed physical freeze definition, not estimated
rule_family.theta_p_estimator: median(freeze_prob) over fold train-window freeze rows (freeze_prob > 0, date <= fold_train_end)
rule_family.entry: first firing row of each episode

fold_estimation.train_for_fold_k: all PIT rows with date <= previous fold train end (seed window for fold 1)
fold_estimation.leakage_guard: thresholds estimated from train rows only; gates applied to fold test rows only
fold_estimation.no_train_freeze_rows: fold fires nothing (no evidence), never a fabricated threshold

anti_gaming: no parameter search over the full window
rule family and theta_p estimator fixed before scoring

roll_jump.halt: flagged roll-date gap >= 1+5*sigma not co-located with a modeled freeze episode -> RollJumpError (INVALID run)

exit_criterion: capable of firing trades under OOS constraints without exploiting roll gaps
